figure_change: Both preview variants now use lynx-round-art.webp at identical fixed geometry in every stage, including completion. The native app star and line layer stays above the artwork. The stardust variant varies a soft reveal mask; the fade-in variant varies opacity from 0 to 1. Completion no longer swaps to a differently framed image.
fade_in_effects: The fixed-geometry fade-in preview adds animated light along constellation connections, particles gathering toward lit stars, arrival light rings, an image-alpha-masked completion sweep, a soft nebula bloom, surrounding star flashes and one-time eye highlights. Animations are cancellable, stop on hidden tabs, and respect reduced motion. The visible preview auto-plays once unless the user interacts or autoplay=0.
completion_breath: A five-second breathing cycle synchronizes a wider alpha-derived mint aura, rim opacity, and artwork brightness/saturation (0.78–1.24 brightness) without transforms or image swaps. Normal completion delays the cycle 3.1 seconds. A direct breathing-preview button starts it immediately, skips completion flashes, and preserves fixed geometry. All layers reset below six stars, on replay, hidden tabs, or reduced-motion preference. CSS cache version breath-2.
